identify_schema_change.expected_solution: Zulip PR #30504 adds a `deactivated` BooleanField to the `NamedUserGroup` model so groups can be soft-deleted instead of removed. The schema change is in `zerver/models/groups.py` (model definition) and a new Django migration named `0578_namedusergroup_deactivated` is added under zerver/migrations/ (single-column add with default=False). At the pinned base SHA the rename from `UserGroup` to `NamedUserGroup` is already complete, so the migration targets the post-rename table only.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify the schema change as a new BooleanField named `deactivated` on NamedUserGroup
Must reference zerver/models/groups.py as the model file changed
Must reference the new migration `0578_namedusergroup_deactivated` added under zerver/migrations/
Should note that PR #30504 is the source of the change

find_direct_refs.expected_solution: Direct references to NamedUserGroup that need to be aware of the new `deactivated` field, per the PR diff: (1) `zerver/actions/user_groups.py` — create/update/membership actions must filter or set `deactivated`; (2) `zerver/views/user_groups.py` — REST endpoints for listing/updating groups; (3) `zerver/lib/user_groups.py` — utility helpers for resolving group queries (`get_recursive_subgroups`, `access_user_group_by_id`); (4) `zerver/views/streams.py` — channel access checks read group membership and must skip deactivated groups. The model itself in `zerver/models/groups.py` declares the field; query helpers in `zerver/lib/user_groups.py` are the chokepoint that downstream actions/views go through.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite zerver/actions/user_groups.py as a direct action-layer reference
Must cite zerver/views/user_groups.py as a direct view-layer reference
Must cite zerver/lib/user_groups.py as the utility chokepoint for group queries
Should cite zerver/views/streams.py because channel access checks consult user_groups

find_indirect_refs.expected_solution: Indirect references — places that don't query NamedUserGroup directly but still must change to track the new column or convey it: (1) `zerver/lib/events.py` — event-system payload for group create/update/delete must carry `deactivated`; (2) `zerver/lib/event_schema.py` — schema validators for outgoing events must accept the new field; (3) `zerver/lib/import_realm.py` — realm import path must restore `deactivated` from JSON exports; (4) `zerver/lib/markdown/__init__.py` — message renderer expands `@*group*` mentions and must skip deactivated groups; (5) `zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml` — public API schema documenting the field; (6) `zerver/openapi/curl_param_value_generators.py` — example value generators for docs; (7) `zerver/models/realm_audit_logs.py` — audit-log entries record group state changes and need a `deactivate`/`reactivate` event type; (8) `zproject/urls.py` — URL routing for any new endpoints added by the change.

Must cite zerver/lib/import_realm.py for the import/export path
